title: Raffle
summary: RAF'FLE, verb intransitive [Heb. to strive. See Raff.] To cast dice for a prize, for which each person concerned in the game lays down a stake, or hazards a part of the value; as, to raffle for a watc

inlines.v: RAF'FLE, verb intransitive [Heb. to strive. See Raff.] To cast dice for a prize, for which each person concerned in the game lays down a stake, or hazards a part of the value; as, to raffle for a watch. RAF'FLE, noun A game of chance, or lottery in which several persons deposit a part of the value of the thing, in consideration of the chance of gaining it. The successful thrower of the dice takes or sweeps the whole.
